title: System programming -- where it stands
thesis: Deliberately not a Go/Rust-std system library: a clean but intentional subset of OS primitives, plus a layer none of them have -- an in-memory rehearsal twin over files, env and spawns, a single narrated/scoped/audited stzUpdatePlan that is the only bridge to reality, and a capability-actor lattice where an inference-only (LLM) actor's effect set is empty by construction. It omits by design what a governed-effects surface doesn't need: signals, broad IPC, the raw syscall zoo.

lanes.note: A capability lattice, a rehearsal twin that touches nothing, stzUpdatePlan as the sole crossing with three gates; an LLM actor's effect set is empty.
lanes.proof: stzSystemActor, stzVirtualSystem, stzUpdatePlan; marker-file guard (queued spawn does not run until commit)

lanes.note: Managed children: Spawn, streaming ReadOutput/ReadError, Wait, ExitCode, Kill, no-leak Close; SystemCall double-exec bug fixed (one spawn).
Get/set/unset/list env, cwd, hostname, username, cpu-count engine-backed; on Windows SetEnvironmentVariableW so later child spawns inherit.
Read/write/append/copy/delete/stat and dir create/delete/list/walk/count screened by pathIsUsable; omits permissions, ownership, symlinks, fifos.
OS/arch/endianness, cpu-count, machine and process memory, declared profiles for non-host targets; facts are engine, opinions are Ring; not a deep sysinfo.
Monotonic ns/us/ms, wall UTC, sleep, resolution; process uptime from a monotonic base instant at DLL load (the epoch-uptime bug fixed and guarded).
define -> require -> feasibility -> plan -> execute -> ship; Deploy(:Production) gated by MayCommit; Git and LocalRepo backends proven byte-for-byte.
stzBuilder + build.zig wasm produce a bundle; stzEmulator rehearses Deploy(:Emulated); stzPlatform refuses to deploy what wasn't built.
reactor.zig is a libuv-backed loop, but only its first slice (version + selftest) ships in this group; no thread-spawn API.
Path helpers and common file/dir ops; permissions, ownership, symlinks, fifos, mmap, users/groups, ptrace, raw syscalls deliberately omitted.
Only the managed child's stdout/stderr/stdin pipes; no named pipes, shared memory or socketpair.
None: grep finds no stz_signal* in the engine and no Ring signal class; no SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGCHLD handling, no graceful shutdown.

standouts: A rehearsal twin over files, env and spawns that touches nothing
stzUpdatePlan: the sole crossing to reality, through three gates (reject, scope, governance)
An inference-only (LLM) actor's effect set is empty by construction -- agents that cannot hurt you
Deploy(:Production) gated by MayCommit; Git and LocalRepo backends proven byte-for-byte
gaps: Complete the process face (ExePath, IsAlive, process table); live-verify ssh/docker/device deploy backends
Richer IPC and the lower OS surface (permissions, symlinks, users/groups); wire the engine sandbox flag
peers: Go std (os, os/exec, os/signal, runtime, time, syscall)
Rust std (process, env, fs, time) + nix, signal-hook, tokio
dated: Read from the source on 2026-09-16, from a read-only main worktree
